label: NOT_EVIDENCE_SPEC_INTERPRETATION_ADJUDICATION
spec_sources: research_state/strategy_spec.md (Crash Trigger: 'Signal: coin's 21-hour RSI closes below 20 (last day almost all selling)'; Entry: 'Buy at next hourly open'; no same-bar rebound confirmation candle required)
crash-rebound-strategy.pdf (spec: RSI(21)<20 crash close -> buy at next hourly open; no same-bar confirm_rebound gate)

adjudication_summary.statement: Does the spec require a same-bar rebound-confirmation candle (canonical confirm_rebound on the signal bar) before the next-open buy, or is the spec-literal reading (RSI(21)<20 close -> buy at next hourly open, no same-bar confirmation) the faithful one?
candidate_readings: SPEC_LITERAL_NEXT_OPEN: no same-bar rebound confirmation; buy at next hourly open per spec text; produces C18 (77 signals, 22 trades, -47,933.58).
CANONICAL_SAME_BAR_RETAINED: same-bar confirm_rebound() required before entry; produces C14 (9 signals, 7 trades, +8,914.33).
adjudication_summary.decision_rule_pre_registered: The reading with direct spec-text support wins. No post-hoc switching.
spec_text_findings: strategy_spec.md Crash Trigger section states only '21-hour RSI closes below 20' as the trigger and 'Buy at next hourly open' as the entry rule.
No clause in the spec requires a same-bar rebound confirmation candle (close > open with body in upper half of range) as a precondition to entry.

confirm_rebound() in src/strategy/crash_rebound.py:288 is an implementation addition not present in the spec text. It is gated behind entry_spec_literal_next_open=False by default, preserving the canonical baseline.
The spec-literal reading (buy at next hourly open after RSI(21)<20 close, no same-bar confirmation) is directly supported by the spec text; the canonical same-bar reading is an implementation extra.
adjudication_summary.consequence: SPEC_LITERAL_NEXT_OPEN wins. Per pre-registered decision rule, the native verdict is NO_GO (C18: 22 trades, -47,933.58 on the same 283-day archive). C14 same-bar result (+8,914.33, 7 trades) is demoted to a non-spec sensitivity, not evidence.
